items.docs: Execute any native API call on a toolkit with authentication automatically injected from Composio. This endpoint proxies HTTP requests to third-party APIs using connected account credentials resolved from the session context. Provide the toolkit slug, API endpoint, and HTTP method — Composio handles authentication injection, abstracting away credential management. Supports all HTTP methods, custom headers/query parameters, and binary request/response bodies.

info.name: Get toolkits for a tool router session

params.name: session_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the tool router session

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of items per page, max allowed is 50

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for pagination. The cursor is a base64 encoded string of the page and limit. The page is the page number and the limit is the number of items per page. The cursor is used to paginate through the items. The cursor is not required for the first page.

params.name: toolkits
params.description: Optional comma-separated list of toolkit slugs to filter by. If provided, only these toolkits will be returned, overriding the session configuration.

params.name: is_connected
params.description: Whether to filter by connected toolkits. If provided, only connected toolkits will be returned.

params.name: search
params.description: Search query to filter toolkits by name, slug, or description

items.docs: Retrieves a cursor-paginated list of toolkits available in the tool router session. Includes toolkit metadata, composio-managed auth schemes, and connected accounts if available. Optionally filter by specific toolkit slugs.

info.name: List tools with schemas for a tool router session

params.name: session_id
params.description: Tool router session ID

items.docs: Returns the tools available in a tool router session with their complete schemas. This includes both meta tools and any preloaded app tools exposed by the session.

info.name: Search for tools using a query

params.name: session_id
params.description: Tool router session ID (trs_*)

items.docs: Search for tools matching a given use case query within a tool router session. Returns matching tool slugs, full tool schemas, toolkit connection statuses, and workflow guidance in a predictable format.

info.name: List files in a session mount

params.name: session_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the tool router session

params.name: mount_id
params.description: ID of the storage mount

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response next_cursor field

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of files to return per page (1-500)

params.name: mount_relative_prefix
params.description: Relative path prefix within the mount for filtering

items.docs: Lists files in a workbench session storage mount with cursor-based pagination. Use the download_url endpoint with the returned mount_relative_path to get a presigned download URL.

info.name: Create a presigned download URL for a mount file

params.name: session_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the tool router session

params.name: mount_id
params.description: ID of the storage mount

items.docs: Generates a presigned download URL for a file in a workbench session mount. Accepts a relative path within the mount.

info.name: Create a presigned upload URL for a mount file

params.name: session_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the tool router session

params.name: mount_id
params.description: ID of the storage mount

items.docs: Generates a presigned upload URL for uploading a file to a workbench session mount. The caller should PUT the file content directly to the returned URL.

info.name: Delete a file from a session mount

params.name: session_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the tool router session

params.name: mount_id
params.description: ID of the storage mount

items.docs: Deletes a file from a workbench session storage mount. S3 delete is idempotent — deleting a non-existent file succeeds silently.
